evidence.title: Range 2026 half-year report: Hong Kong Sandy Ridge campus infrastructure works advancing
evidence.publisher: Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group Company Limited (SZSE 300442)
evidence.attribution: Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group, via CNINFO
evidence.excerpt: Range's half-year report says its Hong Kong Sandy Ridge campus steadily advanced infrastructure works in the first half of 2026, with delivery expected in 2028.
